name: MobFighter
tagline: Fight your way through seven blocky worlds.
description: A blocky third-person action game. Pick one of five fighters (Swordsman, Mage, Archer, Brawler or Druid), battle slimes, beasts and bosses across 49 levels, and build each run with power-up cards. Beat the final world, then keep going in Endless mode.

name: Ten Second Jumper
tagline: Clear every level before the clock runs out.
description: A fast, cute, blocky 2D platformer. Every level is a single screen with a ten second clock. Clear it and the next one starts at once.

name: Swipe Attack
tagline: Swipe to the goal before the enemies catch you.
description: A top-down, turn-by-turn game on a chess-board grid. Each round, swipe a direction to move one tile while the enemies move at the same time. Read their arrows, keep to the beat, and reach the goal on the far side.
